items.title: Mitch Johnson on Harrison Barnes responding well to his uptick in minutes:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Mitch Johnson on Harrison Barnes responding well to his uptick in minutes: 

"It's a luxury as a coach to be able to depend on someone when they may not have a consistent rhythm to what to expect. That's a really hard thing for players in this league...He's been huge for us the last few games."
